name: Orbit
maturity: complete-workflow-implementation; acceptance requires pinned runtime and native receipts

capabilities.description: One workspace of contacts, companies, opportunities, associations, timelines, notes and logged activity, ownership, exact identity, duplicate review and merge, import, search, contactability, deletion, and export.
Signed, provenance-bearing, idempotent signal ingestion with exact identity linking, no browser tracking of Orbit's own, and visible source failures.

Mail sent or forwarded to a private Orbit address, a calendar's private iCal link, owner-supplied files and scoped read-only Google or Microsoft mail/calendar connections become evidence-backed signals; exact replies, delivery reports and stop conditions apply at once, and every other change is a proposal a person accepts, edits or declines. Providers use the owner's OAuth client through capture.source.v1.
One configurable pipeline, versioned scoring, visible evidence, and deterministic NOW/NEXT queue entry without automatic stage changes.

A brief at the top of the operator home and a plan for each meeting, built from records with every line citing its evidence; an optional AI summary sent only as previewed; delegated applications read the brief and propose cited handoffs a person accepts, edits or dismisses.

AI-assisted one-to-one drafts with an explicit human send boundary, provider-aware delivery state, reconciliation of unresolved submissions, stop conditions, unsubscribe handling, and safe scheduling.
Idempotent in-app notifications for changes that need the opportunity owner's attention.

nonGoals: A tracking script, cross-site tracking, fingerprinting, or data-broker identity resolution
Marketing CMS, ads, or multi-touch attribution

env.name: AUTH_ORIGIN
env.requiredWhen: A real mail-auth adapter, signed provider callback, or customer message-link feature is configured.
env.why: Absolute origin for auth, provider callbacks, and customer message links.

env.name: SENDGRID_API_KEY
env.requiredWhen: Direct SendGrid sign-in or operator-approved customer mail is selected.
env.why: Authenticate the owner’s SendGrid account; RER-managed mail uses MAIL_API_KEY instead.

env.name: MAIL_FROM
env.requiredWhen: mail.sender.v1 is configured to issue magic links or send operator-approved one-to-one mail.
env.why: Send magic links and operator-approved one-to-one mail.

env.name: ORBIT_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.requiredWhen: Signed sources, Slack or Google/Microsoft capture connections are configured.
env.why: Encrypt signed-source secrets, Slack credentials, provider tokens and OAuth client secrets in D1.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.requiredWhen: AI generation is configured.
env.why: Authenticate the selected AI provider.

env.name: AI_MODEL
env.requiredWhen: AI generation is configured.
env.why: Select the AI model explicitly.

env.name: AI_INPUT_COST_PER_MILLION
env.requiredWhen: AI generation is configured.
env.why: Estimate AI input token cost for the selected model.

env.name: AI_OUTPUT_COST_PER_MILLION
env.requiredWhen: AI generation is configured.
env.why: Estimate AI output token cost for the selected model.

env.name: MAIL_REPLY_TO
env.requiredWhen: Direct SendGrid customer mail is selected.
env.why: The inbox chosen for customer replies, either an ordinary inbox or the configured Orbit capture address.

env.name: SENDGRID_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_KEY
env.requiredWhen: Provider delivery events, replies or unsubscribe handling is configured.
env.why: Verify SendGrid delivery event signatures.

env.name: SENDGRID_PARSE_PUBLIC_KEY
env.requiredWhen: Provider delivery events, replies or unsubscribe handling is configured.
env.why: Verify SendGrid Inbound Parse signatures.

env.name: AI_CACHED_INPUT_COST_PER_MILLION
env.requiredWhen: Cached-input pricing should be applied to AI cost estimates.
env.why: Estimate cached input cost; without this rate, estimates use the normal input rate and may overestimate.

env.name: SENDGRID_UNSUBSCRIBE_GROUP_ID
env.requiredWhen: Customer outreach is configured.
env.why: Select the provider-managed unsubscribe group for reviewed customer messages.

env.name: RER_MAIL_RELAY_SECRET
env.requiredWhen: A signed provider event relay is configured.
env.why: Verify events addressed to this Orbit deployment by the configured relay.

env.name: OWNER_EMAIL
env.requiredWhen: An installation claims its first owner (rer setup locally, rer deploy when hosted).
env.why: Mailbox of the single initial owner claimed with the setup token.

env.name: SETUP_TOKEN
env.requiredWhen: An installation claims its first owner (rer setup locally, rer deploy when hosted).
env.why: Private one-use proof for the first-owner claim at /auth/bootstrap.

env.name: AUTH_LOCAL
env.requiredWhen: The installation runs on the owner's computer through rer setup and dev.
env.why: Selects local sign-in behind this checkout’s private dev key; never set on a deployment.

env.name: MAIL_PROVIDER
env.requiredWhen: AUTH_LOCAL is true or RER-managed mail is selected.
env.why: Use development for local sign-in suppression, rer for the assigned managed relay, or sendgrid for a direct hosted account. An omitted hosted value retains direct SendGrid behavior.

env.name: MAIL_RELAY_URL
env.requiredWhen: MAIL_PROVIDER is rer.
env.why: The HTTPS mail relay assigned by Run Edit Run hosting, including preview routing.

env.name: MAIL_API_KEY
env.requiredWhen: MAIL_PROVIDER is rer.
env.why: The private key assigned to this installation’s managed mail relay.

env.name: SESSION_SECRET
env.why: Keys Base operator-auth sign-in links, step-up proofs, rate limits and the local CLI's sign-in proof; rer setup and rer deploy generate it once.

env.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER
env.requiredWhen: The owner links an Auth install (oidc-provider@1); left empty, operators sign in by email link.
env.why: The optional identity provider this installation links to through /.well-known/rer-dependencies.

env.name: ORBIT_FORM_TURNSTILE_SECRET
env.requiredWhen: A published form opts in to Cloudflare Turnstile with its site key.
env.why: Verify the opted-in public form challenge before accepting an enquiry.

deploy.notes: Public source and mail event paths require configured signatures. Native auth routes validate origin and one-use tokens; operator APIs and private functions require native sessions. Delegation endpoints require explicit native consent, registered callback and PKCE exchange, then scoped expiring bearer authority; ambient cookies grant no delegated authority.

accessibility.status: prototype automation only; full shared pack pending

operatingCost.assumptions: Cloudflare platform only, excluding buyer-selected mail and AI adapters: Workers Free is the $0 default while daily Worker requests stay at or below 100000, D1 stays at or below 5000000 rows read and 100000 rows written per day, R2 stays within its monthly free tier, and Queues stays at or below 10000 operations per day. Workers Paid is required to sustain the declared 600 signed-ingress requests per minute (864000 requests/day): 600 * 60 * 24 * 30 = 25920000 monthly Worker requests, or 15920000 above the 10000000 Standard-plan inclusion. At $0.30 per additional million, that is $4.78 request overage plus the $5 monthly Paid minimum, rounded up to the $10 high; this excludes CPU, D1 overages, and future Queue fan-out, which must be measured before those capabilities ship. One public IP at the declared 300 requests per minute reaches the Free Worker request ceiling in about 5.6 hours. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/ ; https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/pricing/ ; https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/platform/pricing/
